newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close lower on profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close lower on profit taking.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed lower on profit taking by small investors, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index lost 15.04 points or 1.33 percent at 1,112.05 on a turnover of 31.7 million taka. Of 113 traded issues, 72 lost and 35 gained.

"The market fell despite buying by ICB (Invetsment Corporation of Bangladesh). Everyone (small investors) wanted to cash gains from rises over the past few sessions," said broker Moshtaque Ahmed. Leasing company IDLC gained 1.26 taka to 2,375, Singer Bangladesh fell 210 to 6,771 and Apex Foods was down 20 to 1,901. -- Dhaka Newsroom + 880-2-506363
